note: What a client sends about itself: what it has detected running alongside it, and which appearance it believes it is wearing.

fields.name: moduleOne
fields.note: One of three values a client reports about software it has detected alongside itself. Observed as zero.

fields.name: moduleTwo
fields.note: The second of the three. Observed as zero.

fields.name: appearance
fields.note: The appearance the client believes it is wearing, by the number it knows it as.

fields.name: appearanceCheck
fields.note: A value standing for that appearance's content. A server takes neither this nor the appearance beside it on trust.
